team_new.notCreatedYet: not created yet · Create publishes v1
team_new.goesOnCreate: · goes to the team's server on Create

errors.required: Required: fill this in to create it
errors.takenByServer: Taken in the team · from the server

bar.hint: Create publishes v1 for the team once the server accepts it
bar.fixName: Fix the name to create it
bar.changeName: Change the name, then Create again

computer.profile: Each computer then picks the connection that runs it, asked only when it has several of its CLI kind.
computer.mcpProgram: Each computer then sets the program's path and the values of its variables. A remote URL needs only the values of its secret headers.
computer.mcpRemote: Each computer then gives the value of the secret its header names.
computer.instruction: Nothing to fill in on a computer: an instruction is the same everywhere.
computer.skill: Nothing to fill in on a computer: a skill is the same everywhere.
computer.tool: Each computer then adds the value of each secret the tool names.

profile.nameTaken: The team already has an agent profile named {{name}} · pick another name

mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameSub: Unique in the team; profiles and runs show it
mcp.nameTaken: The team already has an MCP server named {{name}} · pick another name
mcp.folderPathSub: Relative to the run's worktree, never an absolute path
mcp.exemptSub: Agents ask before any other tool
mcp.exemptPlaceholder: Tool names · listed after the first start
mcp.variablesSub: Names only, one per line, e.g. FIGMA_API_KEY: each takes the team secret of its name
mcp.urlSub: http:// or https://, with no key in it
mcp.headerSub: Optional: the header the secret goes in
mcp.secretSub: The team secret whose value it takes, by name
mcp.prefixSub: Written before the value, e.g. Bearer

instruction.name: Name
instruction.nameTaken: The team already has an instruction named {{name}} · pick another name
instruction.addedToSub: Every run is the only choice for now: a profile cannot pick instructions yet

skill.name: Name
skill.nameSub: Lowercase with dashes; agents load it by this name
skill.nameTaken: The team already has a skill named {{name}} · pick another name
skill.descriptionPlaceholder: When agents should use it, in one or two sentences
skill.filesSub: SKILL.md is made from the description. Adding files, importing a folder and choosing the CLIs that load it are not in this form yet

tool.name: Name
tool.nameSub: Agents call it by this name
tool.nameTaken: The team already has a tool named {{name}} · pick another name
tool.programSub: Found on this computer when you create it
tool.unavailableValue: An HTTP request and a database query name secrets by name, which a new tool cannot yet. Create a command.

team_new.personOnly: Only a person creates this: it adds to what agents may do. Press Create yourself; input from an MCP client is refused unless a person lets automation change agent permissions.

nameTaken.title: The team's server refused: the name {{name}} is taken
nameTaken.body: Someone on the team published a resource of this kind with this name. Pick another name and Create again; nothing was created.

notAdmin.title: The team's server refused: you are no longer an admin
notAdmin.body: Nothing was created, and what you typed stays in this form. Only an Admin can create it. Ask an Admin: {{admins}}.

rejected.title: The team's server refused {{name}}
rejected.body: {{reason}} Nothing was created; fix the reason and Create again.

team_new.teamOnly: A team MCP server is made in a team's project.
team_new.localOnly: A local MCP server is made in a local project.
